text: A thin converging lens produces, in its back focal plane, the spatial Fourier transform of the field in its front focal plane.
explanation: True: this is the central result of Fourier optics and the physical basis of 4f processors and diffractive neural networks that perform matrix operations optically. The far-field (Fraunhofer) diffraction pattern is a spatial Fourier transform, and a lens brings that far field to its focal plane.
